purpose: Test whether any simple, pre-specified modification of C0 improves NET risk-adjusted performance after realistic costs. Retain C0 if none does. Failing every variant is a valid and expected outcome.
execution_model: itemised statutory costs (settings.COST_BUY_BPS/COST_SELL_BPS), slippage 10 bps/side, 5% volume participation cap, 2% of 20-day ADV order cap. Decisions use this model only; the legacy flat-cost run is reported for continuity.

windows.walk_forward_blocks: one block per calendar year of entry dates from 2017 to 2024; variants have fixed parameters (nothing is fitted), so each block is an out-of-sample test of the same rule
windows.holdout_rule: opened ONCE per (hypothesis, prereg hash), only for variants that pass every walk-forward criterion; logged in experiments/holdout_log.jsonl; never used to adjust parameters
windows.contamination_note: C0 was selected as best-of-12 variants using data that included 2023-2026, so no historical window is clean for C0 itself. The 2025+ hold-out is untouched by selection of these NEW variants only. Only forward paper data can validate C0.

multiple_testing.note: C0 itself already survived a 12-variant search; its own selection bias is not corrected by this family.

hypotheses.name: relative-strength filter
hypotheses.change: keep trades whose volatility-adjusted momentum (indicator 'mom') ranks in the top 30% of the universe on the signal date

hypotheses.name: near 52-week high
hypotheses.change: keep trades with close within 10% of the 52-week high

hypotheses.name: liquidity floor
hypotheses.change: keep trades with 20-day average traded value >= INR 5 crore

hypotheses.name: higher score bar
hypotheses.change: keep trades with score >= 80 instead of 72

hypotheses.name: bull-regime only
hypotheses.change: skip entries when the Nifty 50 is below its EMA200 on the signal date

hypotheses.name: smaller positions, more of them
hypotheses.change: risk 0.25% per trade with the same 1.5% open-risk cap (up to 6 positions)

walk_forward_pass_criteria.P1_sample: at least 100 trades AND entries in at least 40 distinct calendar months in the design window (a proxy for effective independent observations; trades inside a month are correlated)
walk_forward_pass_criteria.P2_net_edge_vs_C0: paired daily NET portfolio return difference (variant minus C0, design window) has a month-clustered bootstrap CI at alpha_per_test whose LOWER bound is above 0
walk_forward_pass_criteria.P3_consistency: variant net return exceeds C0 net return in at least 5 of the 8 yearly blocks
walk_forward_pass_criteria.P4_absolute: variant design-window net CAGR > 0 after the execution model

holdout_pass_criteria.O1: hold-out net Calmar >= C0 hold-out net Calmar
holdout_pass_criteria.O3: hold-out max drawdown no worse than C0's by more than 2 percentage points

adoption_rule: A variant that passes everything becomes a CANDIDATE (new strategy id), still needing the full forward-validation programme. C0 is never edited or replaced by this study.
diagnostics_not_tests: score predictiveness: Spearman(score, R) and top-minus-bottom tercile gap with month-clustered CIs on the design window; if the lower bounds do not exceed 0 the score is recorded as non-predictive. This does not change C0.
